name: KusuWorks AI ASPアフィリエイトライター
author: kusuworks

sections.description:
KusuWorks AI ASPアフィリエイトライター creates WordPress post drafts using the AI service configured by the site administrator and the product or service information entered by the user.

Features include:

  • Generate article content using a supported AI service.
  • Save generated articles as WordPress drafts for review and editing.
  • Enter an affiliate URL. If the user has the required WordPress capability, raw HTML ad code supplied by an affiliate network can be appended to the end of the generated draft.
  • Generate featured images locally in WordPress, with selectable text content, 10 freely available text designs, font, and text color, plus a bundled fallback image when needed.
  • Manage categories and tags manually in WordPress. This plugin does not automatically assign them.
  • Let WordPress handle post slugs using its standard behavior. The plugin does not generate or overwrite slugs.

The free edition does not include saved offer management, banner management, styled CTA insertion, custom opening or closing greetings, or AI image generation. Review and edit AI-generated content before publication. Check factual accuracy, advertising disclosures, copyright, applicable laws, and the terms of your affiliate program. This plugin does not guarantee search rankings or revenue.

External services

The plugin sends requests to an external AI provider only after an administrator configures that provider and explicitly starts article generation or an API connection test. Depending on the requested operation, the information sent may include product or service names, descriptions, keywords, writing instructions, and generated draft text needed to complete the request. The API key is used for request authentication and is not intended to be included in prompt text. Do not submit confidential or personal information unless you have reviewed the provider’s policies and have the necessary rights to share it.

Provider terms and privacy information:

  • OpenAI API — text generation. Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/ Privacy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/
  • Google Gemini API — text generation. Terms: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Anthropic API — text generation. Terms: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/consumer-terms Privacy: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
  • xAI API — text generation. Terms: https://x.ai/legal/terms-of-service/ Privacy: https://x.ai/legal/privacy-policy/
  • DeepSeek API — text generation. Terms: https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-terms-of-use.html Privacy: https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-privacy-policy.html
  • Mistral AI API — text generation. Terms: https://mistral.ai/terms/ Privacy: https://mistral.ai/terms/#privacy
  • Cohere API — text generation. Terms: https://cohere.com/terms-of-use Privacy: https://cohere.com/privacy

The selected provider processes requests under its current terms and privacy policy. Provider availability, terms, and data practices may change. Featured images are generated locally in WordPress using the text content, design, font, and color selected by the user; no AI image-generation service is used for this feature. When an affiliate URL is provided, a simple text link may be added to the generated draft. The plugin does not add banners or styled CTA blocks. Set categories and tags manually in the WordPress editor.
sections.installation:
1. In the WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin and upload the ZIP file, or use another standard WordPress installation method.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open KusuWorks AI ASPアフィリエイトライター in the WordPress dashboard and configure a supported AI provider and API key.
  4. Enter the product or service information and article settings, then generate a draft.
  5. Review and edit the draft, affiliate links, advertising disclosures, featured image, categories, and tags before publication.

Using an AI provider API may require an account, an API key, and separate fees. A subscription to a provider’s consumer chat service may not include API usage.
sections.faq:
Are articles published automatically?

No. Generated articles are saved as drafts. Review and edit them before publication.

How are post slugs set?

The plugin does not generate or overwrite post slugs. WordPress sets them according to its standard behavior.

Does featured image generation require an external AI service?

No. Featured images are generated locally in WordPress using the selected text and design settings. Generating article text requires the configured AI provider API.

Can I publish generated articles without reviewing them?

Review content before publication. Check accuracy, advertising disclosures, affiliate links, copyright, and the terms of your affiliate program and AI provider.
